conviction_note: The H1 beat against the company's own plan is close to certain (Q1 already 86% of H1 business profit, 95.6% of H1 net) but anyone can compute that from the Q1 短信; the September 月次 in the same batch laps a -8.6% base; against that, the street (FY 経常 18,100) already sits above the company plan (17,550), so the likely held forecast is a mild letdown, and the margin long is crowded at 7.65x. Findings sum to +0.4 and the scaled number is +0.15 (p_up 53 x abs 2.5). The two are measured apart and both say a small lean up.
bar: Company H1 plan, business profit 8,350m yen (OP 8,000m, pre-tax 8,050m, net 5,700m), held at Q1. Source: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260702587250.pdf. FY street consensus 経常 18,100m against company 17,550m, target price 1,800: https://kabuyoho.jp/report?bcode=3612 (one aggregator, no H1 consensus seen, so the bar for the forecast decision is single-source and the guidance finding is capped small).
positioning_check: JPX disclosed short register: 0.0% (no position at or above 0.5%), unchanged, as of 2026-09-29 (baseline, https://www.jpx.co.jp/markets/public/short-selling/index.html). 信用倍率 7.65x, crowded margin long (baseline; kabutan https://kabutan.jp/stock/?code=3612 shows 7.65 on 2026-10-05). No options and no skew. priced_lean_pct -0.242, mostly the margin overhang. 20-day run-up -4.0%, 5-day -2.72%. The stock is about 10% off its 2026-08-25 record of 1,705, part of which is the August-end ex-dividend/優待 drop.

findings.finding: H1 will clear the company's own H1 plan: Q1 business profit 7,171m is already 86% of the 8,350m H1 plan (net 5,451m is 95.6% of 5,700m, against 77.5% at the same point last year), so the plan only needs Q2 business profit of 1,179m against about 1,957m a year earlier; Q2 comps were weak (Jun 87.5, Jul 95.6, Aug 96.3) but store sales rose 0-12% on the new consolidations and the company is deliberately running fewer markdowns.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026-07-03 (same strong-progress story) rose +4.26% next session and made a record high; Q2 a year ago (2025-10-03, held OP, raised net and dividend) fell -0.48% (Yahoo daily closes, https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/3612.T?range=2y&interval=1d).
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: kabutan printed the 95.6% progress the day of Q1 and the stock jumped. What is not yet known is the size of Q2 itself, which the June-August comps make look weak; the stock has drifted 10% off its high as those comps came in, so the market is not holding a large beat.
findings.independence: Monthly sales PDF, a different document, shows store sales +0.3/+9.2/+11.9% and full-price sales above last year in July and August: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260903/140120260903531039.pdf

findings.finding: The full-year forecast (business profit 18,500m, pre-tax 17,550m, net 12,600m) is likely held at this print, against an aggregator consensus of 18,100m 経常 that already sits 3% above the company plan; management has said apparel brands are 'not yet above plan' and cut the FY guide in March 2026 after a weak Q4, so a hold is the likeliest decision and reads as a small letdown against the street.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-03 Q2: OP held, net raised 800m and dividend +3 yen, stock -0.48% next session. 2026-03-12 FY cut (core OP -18%): -3.09% next session, -6.31% over two.
findings.why_not_priced: Inference about a management decision, so sized small. If the market expected a raise to or above 18,100m, the stock would not have given back 10% from its high into the print; if it expected a cut, the consensus would not sit above the plan.
findings.independence: Company revision record: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20251003/140120250922561018.pdf (held OP at Q2 last year) and https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260312/140120260312580763.pdf (March cut).

findings.finding: The September 月次, due on the third business day of October (5 Oct, same 15:30 batch as the results), laps last September's domestic retail 92.8% and comps 91.4%, the weakest month of last year, so it is likely to show the first positive comps after three negative months.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Monthly releases alone move it little: 2026-09-03 August 月次 +0.06% next session; 2026-06-03 May comps back above last year, kabutan '底堅い'.
findings.why_not_priced: The base effect is in last year's table, but the market prices the three negative comps months it has seen; the September number is not public until the release.
findings.independence: Adastria (2685) reported September comps above last year for a third month: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=2685 (2026-10-02). A proxy only.

findings.finding: The Kumamoto earthquake of 28 July closed 19 of World's 38 Kumamoto stores; the company put the August comps drag at about 0.6% and said the profit impact was still being assessed, so the H1 release may quantify a small disaster loss.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior instance on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: disclosed in July and sized in the August 月次. Only the size of any one-off charge is new.
findings.independence: August monthly gives the 0.6% comps estimate: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260903/140120260903531039.pdf

findings.finding: The new progressive dividend policy (payout of at least 40% or DOE of at least 5%, whichever is higher, with buybacks named as a tool) applies from this year; the interim dividend is planned at 31 yen. Last year the company raised its dividend at the Q2 print, but net debt/equity of 1.16x against a 0.75x target makes a buyback unlikely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-03 dividend raise (57 to 60 yen year-end) with the Q2 print: -0.48% next session.
findings.why_not_priced: The policy is public, but any raise would follow a net-profit raise, and that is unannounced. At a 4.4% yield on a margin-long-heavy register, a dividend raise is the item most likely to move it up, and nothing in the price says one is expected.
findings.independence: The net D/E of 1.16x and the 0.75x target come from the Q1 短信: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260703/140120260702587250.pdf

bar_hierarchy: Forecast revision: the H1 plan will almost certainly be beaten; FY likely held against a street number 3% above plan, with a raise possible but not base case. Returns: progressive dividend with interim 31 yen; a raise follows only if net is raised; buyback unlikely (net D/E 1.16x). New-year guide: n/a, H1 print. Quarter: Q1 progress 86% of H1 business profit (net 95.6% vs 77.5% last year), Q2 comps weak but visible in the 月次.
baseline_tension: A mild positive against a mildly negative priced lean (margin overhang 7.65x, -4% run-up). The strongest positive the release could carry is a FY net raise with a dividend raise, as last October; I looked for it and found no pre-release, and last year's version of it bought -0.48%. So the lean is small and p_up stays near 50.
lessons_applied: nothing changed: rule 1 (a negative resting on public 月次 or 進捗率 goes toward 50) was already applied in the draft. The weak Q2 comps were not filed as a negative, the quake finding is sized at -0.1 because it was disclosed, and the H1-beat positive was kept small for the same reason. Rule 2: the set is not negative-tilted, and the strongest positive (FY net/dividend raise) was searched for and recorded in baseline_tension.
